chunks: Neither their wealth nor their children will avail them against God at all. Those are the people of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
ai.seo_question: What provides no protection against God's judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-mal* and *al-walad* as false deities (*al-ilah*) that distract believers from true accountability, particularly in the context of the Day of Resurrection where lineage and wealth lose their social utility. It underscores the futility of worldly accumulation for those who do not purify their souls, serving as a warning against the arrogance of the elite who trust in their status rather than Divine mercy. The eternal abode mentioned here reflects the permanent consequence of prioritizing material assets over spiritual readiness.
